## File: facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/thirdparty/github/fairinternal/postman/third_party/grpc/src/python/grpcio/grpc/framework/interfaces/face/face.py

Prompts

```
['review the GenericStub abstract class and its blocking_unary_unary and future_unary_unary invocation methods', 'review the DynamicStub abstract class that affords RPC invocation via attribute access on method names', 'review the MultiMethodImplementation abstract class and its service method for servicing many RPC methods', 'review the AbortionError exception hierarchy including CancellationError, ExpirationError, and NetworkError subclasses', 'review the Call and ServicerContext abstract classes that extend RpcContext for invocation and service sides', 'create a unary-unary inline RPC method implementation from a behavior callable', 'create a unary-stream inline RPC method implementation that returns an iterator of responses', 'create a stream-stream inline RPC method implementation for bidirectional streaming RPCs', 'create a unary-unary event-driven RPC method implementation using a response callback', 'create a stream-unary event-driven RPC method implementation returning a stream.Consumer for requests']
```

```
